title: Reporting Entitlements by Tier (Corporate Travel Programmes)
content:
Reporting on the Corporate Travel Programmes is graded. Each tier carries a depth of reporting suite — basic, standard, advanced or enterprise — and each tier answers separately whether a monthly savings report against published fares is included in the subscription and whether the programme tracks and reuses unused air tickets on the company's behalf.

| Programme tier | Reporting suite | Monthly savings report | Unused ticket management |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | basic | Not included | Not included |
| Business Team Programme | basic | Not included | Not included |
| Business Pro Programme | standard | Included | Included |
| Business Enterprise Programme | advanced | Included | Included |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | advanced | Included | Included |
| Business Global Programme | enterprise | Included | Included |

Two pairs of tiers share a suite: basic is carried by the Business Starter Programme and the Business Team Programme, and advanced by the Business Enterprise Programme and the Business Enterprise Plus Programme. The savings report and unused ticket management appear together at the same point in the schedule, from the Business Pro Programme upward, so on these programmes no tier carries one of the two without the other.
